title: Block catalog: rules.json
description: One entry per rule id the checks report: the plain-language line shown under What the checks look for in a block that names the rule, or the rule whose line it shares. Read by Neelam.Campaigns.BlockCatalog at startup with System.Text.Json, which also checks what a schema cannot (every rule the checks report is here once, and nothing else is). This schema is checked by the tests only.

description.description: The line shown for this rule.

describedWith.description: A rule whose line also covers this one, so the two show as one line.
